primary_sources.source: G. S. Patterson and S. A. Orszag, Spectral Calculations of Isotropic Turbulence: Efficient Removal of Aliasing Interactions, Phys. Fluids 14 (1971) 2538
primary_sources.used_for: the distinction between transform-grid aliasing and the intended spectral convolution
primary_sources.not_used_for: a theorem that Fourier dealiasing factors transfer unchanged to S3, or removal of a genuine Galerkin projection remainder

primary_sources.source: S. A. Orszag, On the Elimination of Aliasing in Finite-Difference Schemes by Filtering High-Wavenumber Components, J. Atmos. Sci. 28 (1971) 1074
primary_sources.not_used_for: a replacement for an exact basis-specific degree and quadrature certificate

primary_sources.source: L. E. Kidder and L. S. Finn, Spectral Methods for Numerical Relativity: The Initial Data Problem, Phys. Rev. D 62 (2000) 084026
primary_sources.used_for: resolution-ladder and residual-convergence practice in a numerical-relativity constraint setting
primary_sources.not_used_for: automatic exponential convergence, a full ADM constraint algebra, or an anomaly claim

primary_sources.source: L. Lindblom, N. W. Taylor and F. Zhang, Scalar, Vector and Tensor Harmonics on the Three-Sphere, Gen. Rel. Grav. 49 (2017) 139
primary_sources.used_for: unit-S3 harmonic normalization and independent spectral identity context
primary_sources.not_used_for: a complete repository real SVT basis, nonlinear Gaunt table, or HDA closure

primary_sources.source: NIST Digital Library of Mathematical Functions, Chapter 18, Orthogonal Polynomials
primary_sources.used_for: Chebyshev-U orthogonality and the exact Gauss-Chebyshev-U degree budget
primary_sources.not_used_for: physical interpretation of a finite cutoff

upstream_results.role: pins the exact modal Q1+Q2 square and its true N=2 projection remainder

declared_basis_and_evaluators.basis: Q_n(chi)=U_n(cos chi)/sqrt(2*pi^2), with integral_S3 Q_n Q_m=delta_nm
declared_basis_and_evaluators.hard_cutoff: P_N retains Q_0 through Q_N after the exact modal product is formed
declared_basis_and_evaluators.overintegration_rule: choose the smallest M with 2*M-1 >= N+2*d for a retained Q_k, k<=N, and a squared packet of maximum source degree d
declared_basis_and_evaluators.production_rule: M=N+1 nodes, audited rather than presumed dealiased
declared_basis_and_evaluators.aliasing_defect: grid-evaluated retained coefficient minus exact-modal retained coefficient
declared_basis_and_evaluators.true_projection_remainder: the exact-modal coefficients with degree greater than N
